CSDA Evaluation Sites Database

Interactive map of AOIs of the CSDA Evaluation Sites Database

A standardized set of locations for SMEs to reference and use when submitting a CSDA imagery requests associated with evaluations.

Each AOI has:

  • A unique identifier (Site Name)
  • Precise geometric bounds, stored in the corresponding GeoJSON
  • Attributes describing the type of site

AOIs are shown with an arbitrary 25 km vicinity buffer for ease of display, and colored by the source of the evaluation site. Click any site for more details.

Work in progress — AOIs can be added/updated/adjusted. Contact: paul.m.montesano@nasa.gov
